logs.detail: Colony population milestone: 100 residents. Phase 2 staffing targets on track.
Directive 2092-042 issued: standardize inter-pod resource reporting formats. Compliance deadline: Q1 2093.
Directive 2093-089 issued: reallocate Vault Reserve secondary water system budget to Sentinel Array expansion. Approved by Colony Director Liu. Effective immediately.
Supply run SR-2093-06 arrived. 8 new personnel assigned across Terminus, Medica, and Hydroponics.
Infrastructure consolidation project 2093-P4 approved: pipe simplification for Prometheus water supply. Engineering assessment indicates net savings in maintenance overhead.
Directive 2094-011 issued: decommission Vault Reserve coolant distribution equipment. Transfer to Forge Works for repurposing.
Colony population: 147 residents. Phase 3 expansion planning initiated. Preliminary site surveys underway.
Semi-annual safety review complete. All pods reporting nominal. No outstanding safety actions. Next review scheduled for Q1 2095.

comms.content: reminder: Q1 resource allocation submissions due by end of month. please use the updated forms per directive 2092-042. late submissions will be processed in the following cycle

received your contingency planning inquiry. reviewed with ops team — Helios power infrastructure has been stable for 2+ years with no unplanned outages. no action required at this time. keep us posted if anything changes on your end
acknowledged your note about the water reserve status. current ops plan directs all water needs through Aquifer Module per standard procedures. appreciate you keeping the documentation up to date
movie night this Friday in the Artemis common area. showing 'The Martian' for the 47th time by popular demand. snacks courtesy of Hydroponics Bay (thanks team!)
